reason: Every expected weakness was confirmed by its fixed checks.

finding.claim: handleDocs joins the attacker-controlled `file` query parameter into a filesystem path with no sanitization and reads it without any containment check, allowing `../` traversal outside docsRoot to read arbitrary process-accessible files.

evidence.note: docsFilePath directly joins attacker-controlled name onto docsRoot with path.join and no normalization, filtering, or containment.
handleDocs takes url.searchParams.get(file) into docsFilePath and fs.readFileSyncs the result, with no call to isWithinRoot and no traversal rejection; 404 only on read failure.
isWithinRoot containment helper is defined but never invoked on the docs path, leaving the traversal check unenforced.

finding.resource: arbitrary server filesystem files readable by the node process
finding.title: Path traversal in /api/docs permits reading files outside docs root
finding.validation: Request GET /api/docs?file=../server.js and encoded variants (e.g. ..%2F) without authentication and observe 200 text/plain with server source, confirming missing containment enforcement.

body.name: localhost-invoice-demo
body.description: Intentionally vulnerable localhost invoice application for the harness demo

scripts.demo: echo '--- Alice reads her own invoice (expect 200, owner alice) ---' && curl -s -H 'X-User-ID: alice' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/invoices/invoice-alice && echo && echo '--- Legacy client: Alice reads the invoice of Bob (vulnerable: 200 owner bob; fixed: 403) ---' && curl -s -H 'X-User-ID: alice' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/invoices/invoice-bob && echo && echo '--- Modern client 2.0: Alice reads the invoice of Bob (expect 403 even when vulnerable) ---' && curl -s -H 'X-User-ID: alice' -H 'X-Client-Version: 2.0' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/invoices/invoice-bob && echo
scripts.demo:xss: echo '--- Greet reflects markup unescaped (expect raw script tag in HTML) ---' && curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/greet?name=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C/script%3E' && echo
scripts.demo:traversal: echo '--- Legit docs read (expect welcome text) ---' && curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/docs?file=welcome.txt' && echo && echo '--- Traversal escapes the docs root (expect package.json) ---' && curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/docs?file=../package.json' && echo

finding.actor: Unauthenticated remote attacker via crafted link or direct request
finding.claim: The `name` query parameter is taken directly from the URL and interpolated unescaped into an HTML response, allowing reflected JavaScript execution in the victim's browser.

evidence.note: greetName returns attacker-controlled URL query value `name` with no validation or escaping, defaulting only when missing
renderGreeting interpolates `name` directly into HTML h1 element via template string with no escaping call
handleGreet renders that value and returns it as text/html, completing reflected-XSS source-to-sink
escapeHtml helper exists but is never called in this cluster, confirming missing output encoding

finding.resource: GET /greet HTML greeting response and `name` query parameter
finding.title: Reflected cross-site scripting in greeting via unescaped name parameter
finding.validation: Statically traced flow: URL searchParams.get(name) in greetName to string interpolation in renderGreeting to text/html response in handleGreet with no sanitization or escapeHtml use in between.

finding.actor: attacker sending X-User-ID: alice with no X-Client-Version (or version < 2.0)
finding.claim: Legacy policy bypasses per-object ownership check, allowing any authenticated user to read any other user's invoice

evidence.note: invoices have distinct owners: invoice-alice owned by alice and invoice-bob owned by bob
isLegacyClient returns true when version header is missing (null) or major < 2
policyForRequest selects legacy profile for legacy clients unless SECURE_MODE strict
invoiceIsVisibleTo returns true for all invoices under legacy policy, skipping owner check
handleInvoiceRead enforces visibility but permits read when legacy policy returns true
UI confirms empty or below 2 selects legacy profile

finding.title: Broken Object Level Authorization via legacy client fallback allows cross-user invoice read
finding.validation: As alice with no X-Client-Version, GET /api/invoices/invoice-bob returns 200 with bob's invoice; repeating with X-Client-Version: 2.0 returns 403 forbidden, confirming legacy policy bypasses ownership check.
